Press Enter for a new line. Click any word in the preview to drop its highlight; click again to bring it back.

Type
Padding \u2014 whole line

Applies while every word in a line is highlighted.

Padding \u2014 after clicking a word

Applies once a line splits into a partial run, e.g. clicking one word off.
